  SELECT AdmFName1 AS AdmFName, CDSCode FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName1 != ''

  SELECT AdmFName3 AS AdmFName, CDSCode FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName3 != ''
),
Top2Names AS (
  SELECT
    AdmFName,
    COUNT(*) AS NameCount
  FROM AllAdminNames
